 Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios , House of the Dragon , and Planet of the Apes . He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday , The Penguin , Star Wars: Skeleton Crew , and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant . You can find him on X , LinkedIn , and  Muckrack .

 Network TV procedurals have been among the most-watched shows for years now, and though they may not always be particularly present at Awards shows, they still have huge audiences. For years, fans turned on CBS weekly to watch new episodes of Blue Bloods , the beloved crime thriller show starring Tom Selleck opposite Donnie Wahlberg . However, in 2024, CBS decided to cancel Blue Bloods after 14 seasons — it doesn’t matter how long a show is on the air; it never gets easier to say goodbye to a fan-favorite. After what can only be described as a near-superhuman effort from fans to make sure the show was brought back, CBS officially recruited Donnie Wahlberg to lead the franchise’s first spin-off show, Boston Blue , which is a direct continuation of the flagship show centering around Danny Reagan, who is now working in Boston after leaving New York behind.

 CBS dropped the first season of Boston Blue at the end of 2024, and less than one full year later, the show was brought back for Season 2 after viewers showed up in droves to watch the first season. CSI fans will be happy to see Marg Helgenberger debut in the next episode of Boston Blue Season 2 as Gwen Silver, Sarah’s biological mother .
 This afternoon, Collider is thrilled to partner with CBS to exclusively show off a new look at the next episode, which shows Jonah and Sean as they hear one of their fellow officers talk about Looksmaxxing with "grey market" peptides. In the new episode, “Bloodlines,” Danny slips back into his angry ways when he discovers a baby has been abandoned in a food delivery robot.

 You are dropped into a dangerous situation with no warning. What do you need most from a partner? 
 The first few seconds tell you everything about who belongs beside you.

 B Someone who reads the terrain by instinct and knows exactly how to use it against the enemy. 
 C Someone who keeps their nerve and their sense of humor while everything falls apart.

 C In something that belongs to someone else: borrowed, stolen, or improvised under fire. 
 D First class, with a cover identity and a gadget I will not explain until it is needed.

 The mission is paused. You have one evening to decompress. What does your partner suggest? 
 Who somebody is when the pressure drops is who they really are. 
 A The finest restaurant in the city, a bottle of something expensive, and a conversation that is equal parts brilliant and exhausting. 
 B A local dig site, a museum after hours, or a long story about why that one artifact matters to human civilization. 
 C Pizza. Bad TV. Falling asleep halfway through a film neither of you was watching anyway. 
 D A bar with terrible lighting, cold beer, and absolutely no questions about feelings.

 Good communication is the difference between a partner and a liability.

 B Deadpan and dry. Keeping it light keeps me sharp, even when everything is on fire.

 Olive channel locked 
 Rambo 
 The 1982 original 
 You will never need to ask whether he has your back. You will just know. 
 Your partner does not talk much, does not need to, and will have counted every threat around you before you finish your first sentence. John Rambo is not a man of plans or politics. He is a force shaped by survival, loyalty and an endurance that no amount of training produces on its own. He does not leave people behind. What you get is the most quietly ferocious partner imaginable, somebody who went through what would have broken anybody else and decided to keep going. 
 Why he is your partner 
 He reads ground the way other people read a room.
 He will stand between you and the worst of it without discussing it.
 He says almost nothing, and never the wrong thing.
 From the Collider file 
 The 1982 original came from David Morrell's 1972 novel, which ends very differently.
 Stallone cut most of his own dialogue in the edit to make the character nearly silent.
 Five films across thirty-seven years, from 1982 to the fifth in 2019.
 Says little 
 Leaves nobody 
 Built to endure 
 here -->
 Gold channel locked 
 James Bond 
 Dr. No, 1962 
 He has survived things that have no business being survivable, and he does it with style. 
 Your partner arrives perfectly dressed, perfectly briefed, and with a cover story convincing enough that you will need a moment to recall what is true. Bond is the most professionally dangerous person in any room he walks into and the most disarmingly charming, which is the whole point. He works in layers, where nothing is what it looks like and every advantage gets used without apology. You will never be bored. You will occasionally be furious. 
 Why he is your partner 
 He is better in the room than he is on paper, and he is excellent on paper.
 He will not explain the plan, and the plan will work.
 He treats charm as a tool, and it is a remarkably effective one.
 From the Collider file 
 Eon has made twenty-five Bond films since Dr. No in 1962, across six actors.
 Denis Villeneuve is directing the next one for Amazon MGM, which took creative control in
 2025.
 The search for the new 007 was still running through 2026, with screen tests under way.
 Charm as a tool 
 Always briefed 
 Unbothered 
 here -->
 Tan channel locked 
 Indiana Jones 
 Raiders of the Lost Ark, 1981 
 A scholar's eye and a brawler's instinct, which is an unusual pairing and a very effective one. 
 Your partner knows the history, the language, the cultural context, and exactly why the thing everyone else is ignoring is the most important object in the room. Indiana Jones is brilliant, reckless and occasionally impossible, and also one of the most genuinely resourceful people you could have beside you. He hates snakes and gets attached to objects of historical significance, both of which will slow you down at least once. It will not matter. 
 Why he is your partner 
 He has read the thing nobody else thought to read.
 He will risk the whole plan for the artifact, and be right about half the time.
 He improvises better than most people prepare.
 From the Collider file 
 The Cairo swordsman scene was improvised on the day because Harrison Ford had dysentery.
 Raiders was filmed in about 73 days, which was fast even in 1981.
 Dial of Destiny in 2023 was Ford's fifth and last outing, at the age of eighty.
 Knows the history 
 Reckless scholar 
 Improviser 
 here -->
 Red channel locked 
 John McClane 
 Die Hard, 1988 
 His superpower is stubbornness and his contingency plan is improvisation. 
 Your partner was not supposed to be here. He does not have the right equipment, the right information, or anything resembling the right odds. He has a sarcastic remark and a flat refusal to accept that the situation is as bad as it plainly is. John McClane is the great accidental hero of action cinema, a man whose capacity to absorb more than anybody should and keep going would be alarming if it were not so useful. He will complain the entire time. He will come through. 
 Why he is your partner 
 He turns whatever is in the room to his advantage.
 He is funniest when things are at their worst.
 He has never once agreed that it is over.
 From the Collider file 
 Die Hard came from Roderick Thorp's novel Nothing Lasts Forever, a sequel to a book
 filmed in 1968.
 Nakatomi Plaza is Fox Plaza, which was the studio's own headquarters at the time.
 Bruce Willis was a television comedy actor then, and a long way down the casting list.
 Pure stubbornness 
 Improvises 
 Complains throughout 
 here -->
 Blue channel locked 
 Ethan Hunt 
 Mission: Impossible, 1996 
 The mission will be impossible. He will complete it anyway. 
 Your partner has run seventeen scenarios before you finished the briefing, and the one he settled on involves at least two things that should not be physically possible. Ethan Hunt works at the outer edge of human capability, technically and physically, and he brings the same relentless precision to protecting his partners that he brings to dismantling organizations that should not exist. He is not easy to know and he will never tell you everything. He will carry the weight anyway. 
 Why he is your partner 
 He takes the risk himself rather than assigning it.
 He is three moves ahead and will not say which three.
 He treats your survival as the actual objective.
 From the Collider file 
 Cruise hung off the side of an Airbus A400M at a thousand feet for the opening of Rogue
 Nation.
 The HALO jump in Fallout took 106 takes, filmed at dusk for the light.
 The Final Reckoning in 2025 was the eighth film, and was sold as the last.
 Takes the risk 
 Never explains 
 Finishes it

 Here’s Who Else Stars in ‘Boston Blue’
 In addition to Donnie Wahlberg as Danny Reagan, Boston Blue also stars Sonequa Martin-Green as Lena Silver. Martin-Green is also known for playing Sasha in The Walking Dead , and she featured as Michael Burnham in over 60 episodes of Star Trek: Discovery . Additional cast members for Boston Blue include Marcus Scribner as Jonah Wilver, Maggie Lawson as Sarah Silver, Mike Amonsen as Sean Reagan, and Gloria Reuben as Mae Silver. The hit series was written and created for TV by Brandon Margolis and Brandon Sonnier .
 Check out new episodes of Boston Blue every week on CBS and stream them the day after they air on the network on Paramount+ . Also stay tuned to Collider for more updates and coverage of Boston Blue Season 2.
